name_zh: 土库曼·别尔德穆哈梅多夫：永久中性与阿哈尔捷金天然气外交
name_en: Turkmenistan Berdimuhamedov: Permanent Neutrality & Akhal-Teke Natural Gas Diplomacy
description_zh: 古尔班古利·别尔德穆哈梅多夫 (1957-) 土库曼斯坦总统 (2007-2022)，继承尼亚佐夫个人崇拜体制，坚持联合国认定永久中立国地位，以阿哈尔捷金天马文化软实力配合天然气硬实力，在中俄美伊大国博弈中维持战略自主。
description_en: Gurbanguly Berdimuhamedov (1957-) Turkmenistan President (2007-2022), inherited Niyazov personality cult system, upheld UN-recognized permanent neutrality status, combined Akhal-Teke heavenly horse cultural soft power with natural gas hard power, maintained strategic autonomy in China Russia US Iran great power competition.
reason_zh: 别尔德穆哈梅多夫代表中亚永久中性国的独特生存模式，展示了资源型小国如何通过法律地位中立化、文化软实力与能源硬实力双重杠杆在大国夹缝中生存发展。
reason_en: Berdimuhamedov represents unique Central Asian permanent neutral state survival model, demonstrating how resource small state survives in great power squeeze through legal neutrality, cultural soft power and energy hard power dual leverage.
steps_zh: 研究别尔德穆哈梅多夫早年牙医与尼亚佐夫卫生部长经历
分析2007年继任与永久中性国地位维护
探讨阿哈尔捷金天马文化外交与中国天然气管道硬实力
评估2015年联合国永久中性地位重申与多边外交平衡
总结2022年交权儿子谢尔达尔与家族世袭化倾向
steps_en: Study Berdimuhamedov early dentist and Niyazov Health Minister experience
Analyze 2007 succession and permanent neutrality status maintenance
Explore Akhal-Teke horse cultural diplomacy and China gas pipeline hard power
Evaluate 2015 UN permanent neutrality reaffirmation and multilateral diplomacy balance
Summarize 2022 handover to son Serdar and family hereditary tendency
expected_zh: 理解永久中性国法律地位如何转化为生存策略，掌握文化软实力与能源硬实力互补机制，评估土库曼模式对中亚小国战略自主的启示与局限。
expected_en: Understand how permanent neutral legal status converts to survival strategy, grasp cultural soft power and energy hard power complementarity mechanism, evaluate Turkmen model implications and limits for Central Asian small state strategic autonomy.
case_zh: 1995 联合国认定永久中性；2007 别尔德穆哈梅多夫继任；2009 中土天然气管道通气；2022 谢尔达尔继任。永久中性阿哈尔捷金天然气范式永存。
case_en: 1995 UN recognized permanent neutrality; 2007 Berdimuhamedov succeeded; 2009 China-Turkmenistan gas pipeline operational; 2022 Serdar succeeded. Permanent neutrality Akhal-Teke natural gas paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Permanent neutrality model; cultural soft power; energy diplomacy; family succession
